name: Semantic Reference
description: Connected concepts, entities and sourced relationships. Reusable knowledge stores, dictionaries, educational and cultural references.
reference_use_case: Reusable knowledge stores, dictionaries, educational and cultural references.
integrity_rule: Distinguish assertions from instructional projections and record sources.
antipattern: Do not mistake a teaching projection for the complete source record.
design_question: Which concepts, sources and contexts does this knowledge state own?
situational_schema: Source-linked concepts, entities and typed relationships arranged in related thematic clusters.
